signals.thesis: GE Aerospace hits an all-time high ($352.88) on +2.8% as industrials lead the rotation out of tech. BUY signal Jun 12 with RSI 69.4 still below overbought. MACD (11.0 > 8.5 signal) is strongly bullish. Price +9% above EMA50 and +19% above EMA200. The defense/aerospace leader benefits from commercial aviation recovery + military spending increases. Entry on VWAP pullback from today's ATH sprint; stop below EMA20 ($323) at 1.5× ATR.

FCX at $70.15 trades near its 52-week high ($72.09) with a BUY signal since Jun 11. The world's largest publicly traded copper producer benefits directly from the AI data-center buildout (copper wiring demand) and global electrification. RSI 59.8 is healthy, MACD bullish (1.42 > 1.10). Price +9.4% above EMA50 with strong uptrend structure. Options flow shows large ITM call IV spikes. Entry near the breakout zone, stop below EMA50.

Santander breaks to a new 52-week high ($13.48) at $13.38 (+1.8%) extending a relentless EU financials re-rating. BUY signal Jun 11, bullish MACD. EMA20 ($12.47) > EMA50 ($12.22) > EMA200 ($11.17) = textbook uptrend. Forward P/E ~10x remains cheap vs US peers. RSI 65.8 well below overbought. Options show bullish ITM call IV spikes. Third consecutive scan selection — consistency confirms the trend.

Roblox surges +8.1% to $49.34 with a fresh BUY signal (Jun 15, yesterday). The user-generated gaming platform is rebuilding from its -67% drawdown from 52w highs. RSI 58.8 is moderate despite today's spike. Options activity is the most bullish in the scan — massive call volume spikes at strikes $48-52 (3-7× average) with IV spikes across the board. Below EMA50 ($49.14) but reclaiming it with today's move. Contrarian recovery play with smart money confirmation.

stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
